h2: Plumber & Pool Service in Kuta & Legian – Bali Fix
intro: Bali Fix provides plumber and pool service across Kuta, Legian, Tuban, and the Jl. Padma corridor—streets where decades-old plumbing meets coastal salt air and monsoon flooding. From blocked drains to corroded water heaters and tired pools, we handle the repairs that keep your villa or guesthouse running smoothly.

sections.h3: What Breaks Most in This Area
sections.text: Decades-old pipes, drains, and septic systems form the backbone of most properties here, making blockages and slow leaks the single most common call-out. Salt-laden air off Kuta Beach accelerates corrosion on metal fittings, while guesthouses and small hotels push toilets, mixers, and water heaters through heavy daily use. The combination means components fail earlier than you'd expect in a newer build.

Blocked drains and toilets lead our work list, followed closely by water leak repairs and water heater replacements. Low-lying lanes near the beach flood during heavy rain, sending debris into already fragile drain lines. Villa managers running multiple units also rely on us for regular pool cleaning, septic maintenance, and pump or filter swaps when salt damage takes its toll.

sections.h3: Neighbourhoods Covered by Our Plumber & Pool Service
sections.text: We work across Kuta, Legian, Tuban, Kuta Beach, and every side street along Jl. Padma without exception. Whether it is one bathroom in an older home or a full guesthouse with twenty rooms cycling through guests daily, the job gets done. Send photos over WhatsApp and we will put together a fair quote before anyone arrives at your door.

Wet season (roughly November to March) brings more drain back-ups and flooding on low-lying lanes, so clearing gutters and checking septic levels beforehand saves real headaches. In drier months, coastal salt air works harder on exposed fittings—worth inspecting pool ladders, pump housings, and outdoor taps every few weeks. A short seasonal check-up keeps small issues from snowballing into costly repairs.

faq.q: Do you cover all of Kuta and Legian, including Tuban?
faq.a: Yes—we service every street in Kuta, Legian, Tuban, Kuta Beach, and the Jl. Padma area. Just send us a message on WhatsApp with your address and what's going wrong.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for a blocked drain or leaking tap?
faq.a: Snap a couple of photos showing the issue and send them over WhatsApp. We'll look at them and give you a clear estimate based on the actual job—no fixed rate sheet, since every property here is different.

faq.q: How often should I book pool cleaning near the beach?
faq.a: Salt air and dust mean pools in this stretch need attention more frequently than inland ones. Most villa managers schedule regular pool service weekly or fortnightly; we can recommend a rhythm that fits your usage when you first set up an account with us.
